description: This file defines functions and constants related to the mapping and positioning of Synchronization Signal Blocks (SSB) in 5G NR, including calculation of the first OFDM symbol, subcarrier position, maximum SSB occasions, and CRB intervals, with references to 3GPP specifications.

methods.name: ssb_get_l_first
methods.description: Calculates the first OFDM symbol index in a 5ms SS/PBCH block burst based on pattern case and SSB index.

methods.name: ssb_get_k_first
methods.description: Calculates the subcarrier index of the first SS/PBCH block relative to Point A, considering frequency range, SCS, and offsets.

methods.name: ssb_get_L_max
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of SSB occasions per SSB period based on SSB SCS and DL ARFCN.

methods.name: get_ssb_crbs
methods.description: Calculates the CRB interval where the SSB is allocated, referencing SCS common grid.
